name: Last Exile: Ginyoku no Fam
name_english: Last Exile: Fam, the Silver Wing
original_title: ラストエグザイル-銀翼のファム-
description: Aerial adventures continue in the sky above the world of Prester.

episodes.name: Açık dosya
episodes.description: Kutsal Büyük Göl'ün üzerindeki göklerde Ades Federasyonu, Turan krallığına savaş ilan eder. Turan sancak gemisinin yok edilmesi kaçınılmaz göründüğünde, Fam adlı bir Gökyüzü Korsanı cesurca "Kararımı verdim! O gemiyi çalacağım!"

episodes.name: aptalın arkadaşı
episodes.description: Prenses Liliana, kraliyet şehrini Federasyon saldırısından koruma talimatıyla birlikte Iglasia'ya gönderilir. Bu sırada Prenses Millia da sürpriz bir saldırı hazırlar ama Luscinia'nın da bir numarası olduğundan habersizdir...

episodes.name: Işık Meydanı
episodes.description: Artık krallığı Federasyon kontrolünde olan Prenses Millia, sonunda bir Gökyüzü Korsanı olmanın ne demek olduğunu anlamaya başlar. Fam ayrıca geçmişi ve gelecek hayaliyle ilgili ayrıntıları da açıklıyor.

episodes.name: Dokun ve Taşı
episodes.description: Millia, Fam'in Silvius'un kaptanı Tatiana ile özgürlükleri karşılığında Ades Federasyonu'nun 15 filosunu ele geçirmek için bir anlaşma yaptığını öğrenince şaşkına döner.

episodes.name: Over Step
episodes.description: In the hope of capturing their next battleship, Fam and company visit Eldorado, an amusement center where underground Vanship races are held.

episodes.name: Weak Square
episodes.description: With only one ship left until their agreement with Tatiana is fulfilled, Fam and company aim to capture a fleet of eight ships being transported from the north.

episodes.name: Connected Passed Pawn
episodes.description: The final target was the Anshar, the flagship of the Ades Federation's 1st Fleet. Now that their agreement with Tatiana has been fulfilled, Giselle prepares to leave the Silvius... but without Fam.

episodes.name: Illegal Move
episodes.description: Much to Fam and friends' elation, Turan and Anatoray form an alliance with Millia and Vincent acting as delegates. Suddenly the Impetus, an Ades Federation flagship, appears... along with Luscinia and Liliana.

episodes.name: Backward Pawn
episodes.description: Ten years ago, the first Grand Race was held. A young Fam and Giselle cheer on Atamora as he competes in the championship race.

episodes.name: Engellemek
episodes.description: Fam ve arkadaşları kuzeydeki Buzullar ulusuna acil iniş yaptıklarında, Dyan adında bir kız tarafından karşılanırlar.

episodes.name: Bad Move
episodes.description: The Winged Priestesses, led by Dyan, engage the Ades Federation armada in battle as it begins to invade Glacies.

episodes.name: Smothered Mate
episodes.description: Fam and friends return to Kartoffel after their long absence. The joy of seeing everyone safe and sound again turns to shock as Fam sees what has happened to the town.

episodes.name: Triangulation
episodes.description: Millia and friends have an audience with Augusta Sara in the capital city of Morvarid.

episodes.name: Automaton
episodes.description: The Ades Federation's 3rd and 4th Fleets advance on the key strategic land of Boreas. A decisive, multi-fleet battle over Augusta Sara ensues. Millia takes command of her fleet, while Fam and the Sky Pirates take to the air in armed Vespas.

episodes.name: Dinamik Olanaklar
episodes.description: Dio ve Alvis, Boreas'ta Müşterek Kuvvetlerle buluşur ve büyük bir yardım eli uzatır. Ancak Fam'in grubu, devriye gezerken Ades'in 1. Filosunu görünce sevinçleri kesintiye uğrar.

episodes.name: Transposition
episodes.description: Upon hearing Sārā's wish, Admiral Sadri agrees to peace. A meeting takes place between Luscinia, Liliana, Sārā, Millia, Vasant, and others.

episodes.name: Queening Square
episodes.description: The truce has fallen apart. Before leaving, Luscinia tells Fam, "Be there to support Princess Millia."

episodes.name: Triple Rook
episodes.description: After abducting Augusta Sara, Luscinia activates the Grand Exile.

episodes.name: Grand Master
episodes.description: Fam and Giselle reach the furthest depths of the Grand Exile. There, they find Luscinia, holding a sleeping Sārā.
